lines.zh: 我的四条短腿一步一步踩过去。
lines.en: My four short legs step along.
Iron grey shows through my hide.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，像在省着用。
lines.en: I walk slowly, as if rationing myself.

lines.zh: 我避开石头，怕提前撞坏。
lines.en: I avoid stones; I might break too soon.

lines.zh: 我四条腿压过碎石，没有响。
lines.en: My four legs cross the gravel without a sound.
I walk along the edge of the vein.
I stop and sniff a stone.
The flecks on me glint.
I pass a wall and brush against it.

lines.zh: 我离你近了，又退开一点。
lines.en: I come near you, then ease back.
I drag a small glow with me.
I watch you while I walk.

lines.zh: 我踩过一片碎石，碎石灰了。
lines.en: I cross a spread of gravel; it turns grey.
I walk toward deeper ground.

lines.zh: 我的腿一下一下，很有节奏。
lines.en: My legs move in a steady rhythm.

lines.zh: 我绕过一株草，不想踩坏。
lines.en: I step around a blade of grass.
I stand, my body pulsing softly.
The smell of iron hangs on me.
The soil at my feet has greyed.
I look up at you, then down.

lines.zh: 我量着脚下这层石头的厚度。
lines.en: I measure the thickness of the stone beneath me.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，掉下一点粉末。
lines.en: I shudder; a little powder falls.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地吸气，身体鼓起来。
lines.en: I draw breath and swell.
I am in no hurry to act.

lines.zh: 我盯着一块裸露的石头。
lines.en: I stare at a bare stone.

lines.zh: 我的光像呼吸一样起伏。
lines.en: My glow rises and falls like breathing.
I am counting my own steps.

lines.zh: 我静止时几乎像一块矿石。
lines.en: At rest I almost look like ore.
I rub the ground and leave grey.
I turn slowly toward the sound.

lines.zh: 我沉下去，像一块铁矿石。
lines.en: I sink down until I look like ore.

lines.zh: 我蹲在铁脉边，一动不动。
lines.en: I crouch by the iron vein, still.
We face each other. You are taller.

lines.zh: 我抬头，身上的铁点发亮。
lines.en: I look up; my iron flecks shine.
I am judging how far off you are.
One step closer and I inhale.
You step back, and I deflate.
I do not cry out. I do not chase.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在你脚边停住。
lines.en: My eyes stop at your feet.

lines.zh: 你这样看着我，我不会改主意。
lines.en: Staring at me will not change my mind.

lines.zh: 我把重心全压到四条短腿上。
lines.en: I sink all my weight onto four short legs.
My flecks keep glinting.

lines.zh: 我在你身上找铁的味道。
lines.en: I check you for the smell of iron.
You are standing just right. Do not move.
I deflate, then swell again.
My seam has lengthened.
I back half a step; my glow dims.
A little ash falls from me.
I shudder, and iron flecks scatter.
I sink to guard my middle.

lines.zh: 我身体里闷闷地响了一下。
lines.en: Something thuds dully inside me.

lines.zh: 我压住火气，不让它早炸。
lines.en: I hold the blast back so it will not go early.

lines.zh: 我一步一停地退进暗处。
lines.en: I retreat into the dark, a step at a time.
I push the pressure back down.
I walk around it and keep hunting iron.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，我不过去。
lines.en: You set it down. I do not go to it.
I glance once and look away.
That has nothing to do with my purpose.
You mean to lure me off. It will not work.
I walk around it.
I nose it back to you.

lines.zh: 我把注意力放回你身上。
lines.en: I put my attention back on you.
You hold it up a long while.
I neither approach nor leave.

lines.zh: 我停在它前面，没有再近。
lines.en: I stop before it and come no closer.

lines.zh: 你把它放在我脚下，我还是不动。
lines.en: You set it at my feet. I still do not move.

lines.zh: 我一脚把它碾进碎石堆。
lines.en: One step grinds it into the gravel.

lines.zh: 这东西塞不进我的裂缝。
lines.en: This thing will not fit into my cracks.
I look at it and think of something else.
Take it away.
You bump me; I swell.

lines.zh: 我的重心低，你推不歪我。
lines.en: My weight sits low; you cannot tip me.

lines.zh: 你退开时，脚下留下了灰。
lines.en: You leave grey prints as you back off.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，我整块沉了一下。
lines.en: You hit me, and my whole body sinks a notch.
A little iron dust falls off me.

lines.zh: 我侧身避开，不想这么早炸。
lines.en: I turn aside. I do not want to burst yet.
You step on me; I pull my leg in.

lines.zh: 我不生气，我只是往后退。
lines.en: I am not angry. I only step back.
I steady my weight.

lines.zh: 我们分开，距离恢复原样。
lines.en: We part, and the distance is as before.
Another one carries iron flecks too.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，一起鼓动。
lines.en: We stand side by side, pulsing together.
We trade a little powder.
Its grey is deeper than mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起把脚下的土染灰。
lines.en: Together we grey the soil beneath us.

lines.zh: 它靠过来，我也没有让开。
lines.en: It leans in. I do not give way.
We inhale at the same moment.

lines.zh: 我们之间有一层薄薄的光。
lines.en: A thin light lies between us.
It eases back; so do I.

lines.zh: 我们把这块地变成铁的颜色。
lines.en: We turn this patch the color of iron.

lines.zh: 我把它按进铁灰色的地面。
lines.en: I press it into the iron-grey ground.

lines.zh: 我压住它，等它慢慢泛灰。
lines.en: I press it down and wait for it to grey.
I pick it up and put it down.
This cannot be eaten.
I push it beside a stone.
It slowly greys under my feet.
I sniff. Nothing.
I kick it toward the gravel heap.
I look at it a long while.
I leave it and walk on.
You have come inside my distance.

lines.zh: 我吸了一口气，身体鼓起来。
lines.en: I draw breath and swell.
I begin to pulse, faster and faster.
I take one step toward you.

lines.zh: 你会自己走进我的范围里。
lines.en: You will walk into my range on your own.
Retreating will not help.

lines.zh: 我的斑点齐齐亮起，像锻过。
lines.en: My spots flare together, like forged metal.

lines.zh: 你脚下这块石面，我已经圈好。
lines.en: The patch under your feet is already marked.

lines.zh: 这里就是我要炸的地方。
lines.en: This is where I mean to burst.
You have a little time to get clear.
I close in, step by step.
You run; I keep walking.
I am in no hurry. My time is enough.
You shoot me; I still advance.

lines.zh: 我的斑点一个接一个亮起来。
lines.en: My spots light up one after another.
You shut the door; I push it open.

lines.zh: 我数着你脚下石板的块数。
lines.en: I count the slabs under your feet.
I shorten the gap bit by bit.
You should not stand by the stones.
My steps quicken.

lines.zh: 我不出手，我的方式是炸。
lines.en: I do not strike. My way is to burst.

lines.zh: 我只顶了你一下，不是炸。
lines.en: I only nudge you; this is no blast.
I press close; the light is hot.
My seam lines up with you.
You step back. Perfect.
I swell to the fullest, then stop.
I burst, and it does not hurt you.
In the light, the stone changes color.

lines.zh: 我炸出的范围比我想的大。
lines.en: The burst reaches further than I thought.
I look at you one last time.
I appear beside a vein.
The stone under me greys.

lines.zh: 我先鼓了一下，确认自己。
lines.en: I swell once to check myself.

lines.zh: 我从碎石里拱出来，抖掉铁屑。
lines.en: I push up out of the gravel and shake off iron dust.
There is a lot of stone here.
I walk toward the smell of iron.

lines.zh: 我停在一块铁灰色的裸岩上。
lines.en: I settle on a bare iron-grey rock.

lines.zh: 我的斑点第一次亮起来。
lines.en: My flecks light for the first time.
I know where I am meant to go.
I begin measuring distances.

lines.zh: 火点着我的引线，我却还没到。
lines.en: Fire takes my fuse, and I am not there yet.
I fall, and every seam opens.
Water presses me down; the fuse drowns.

lines.zh: 别的爆炸先把我的引线点了。
lines.en: Another blast lights my fuse first.

lines.zh: 箭卡在我铁壳的裂口里。
lines.en: The arrow lodges in a crack of my iron shell.

lines.zh: 那光把我的压力抽走了一截。
lines.en: That light draws off some of my pressure.

lines.zh: 我太久没碰到石头，快散了。
lines.en: Too long without stone; I am coming apart.

lines.zh: 雷提前点了我，我还没准备好。
lines.en: Lightning fires me early. I was not ready.

lines.zh: 我被拽出世界，铁还是铁。
lines.en: I am torn out of the world; iron stays iron.
